description: This file is a source code for a JavaScript module that deobfuscates minified JavaScript stack traces using source maps. It includes argument parsing, source map fetching and caching, stack trace parsing, and source map consumption to resolve original source positions and symbols.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into options object.

methods.name: findInRepo
methods.description: Searches the repository for a file matching a suffix, trying progressively shorter suffixes.

methods.name: resolveSourcePathAsync
methods.description: Resolves a source file path, attempting local, cached, or remote sources, with fuzzy fallback.

methods.name: findRepoRoot
methods.description: Finds the root directory of the git repository by looking for a .git folder.

methods.name: printHelp
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: parseStackTrace
methods.description: Parses raw stack trace text into structured frames with URL, line, and column info.

methods.name: fetchRemote
methods.description: Fetches a URL over HTTP/HTTPS and returns the response body as a string.

methods.name: loadSourceMap
methods.description: Loads a source map file from local, cache, or remote source.

methods.name: tryDemangleDotted
methods.description: Attempts to resolve dotted minified symbols to original names using source map data.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Retrieves source code lines around a specific line and column for context display.

methods.name: getConsumer
methods.description: Lazily loads the source-map consumer module and creates a consumer instance from raw JSON.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates parsing, source map loading, and stack trace deobfuscation.
